name: Soukou Seiki Ysphere ~Ingyaku no Sennou Kaizou~
original_name: 装煌聖姫イースフィア～淫虐の洗脳改造～
source:
Omega is an anti-humanity institution purposed to dominate the whole world.
With artificial humans created by an unequaled scientist, Void, they have destroyed cities and hunted people.

The police and military forces were no match against Omega's artificial humans and innocent people have barely survived through their attacks.

By the name of Yisphere, Shizuku Ayazaki and Natsumi Fujii acquired the power to repel Omega's forces and are fighting for the peace.

Wearing special battle wears which convert their righteous spirits into physical forces, they bring down to Omega's artificial humans.

As Void takes them as a thorn in the side of his scheme, he formulates and implements a project to eliminate them from the situation.

Supposing their justice minds are the very source of their power, his project aims to bend and reprogram their minds into those of sex slaves.

By the plan is his own technology...brainwashing hypnotism.

Yisphere's determined beliefs will be overwritten by a course of brainwashing hypnotism and enslaving disciplines and they will go in the wrong direction, which leads to a bottomless hell of sexual pleasure...!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE245808.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
欧米伽是一个旨在统治全世界的反人类组织。他们利用天才科学家虚空制造的人工人类，摧毁城市、猎杀人类。

警察与军队都不是欧米伽人工人类的对手，无辜者只能勉强在攻击中求生。

绫崎雫与藤井夏海以“伊斯菲亚”的名义获得击退欧米伽势力的力量，为和平而战。她们穿着能将正义精神转化为物理力量的特殊战斗服，击败欧米伽人工人类。

虚空将她们视为计划中的眼中钉，于是制定并实施了排除她们的计划。既然正义之心正是她们力量的来源，他便试图把她们的思想扭曲、重编程为性奴隶。

计划依靠他自己的技术：洗脑催眠。

伊斯菲亚坚定的信念将被洗脑催眠、奴役训练逐步覆盖，她们会走向错误方向，坠入无底的性快感地狱……！
